messages.subject: Call for instructors: Bioconductor Carpentry workshops at EuroBioc2025
messages.subject_clean: Call for instructors: Bioconductor Carpentry workshops at EuroBioc2025
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

We're seeking Carpentries-certified instructors for Bioconductor Carpentry workshops that will be held before the EuroBioC2025 conference in Barcelona, Spain in September. Ideally, you’ll be attending EuroBioC2025 (September 17th-19th), but that’s not mandatory. We will provide funds to cover 2 nights’ accommodation.

The Bioconductor Carpentry workshops we plan to run September 15th-16th are the RNA-Seq Analysis with Bioconductor <https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/bioc-rnaseq/> and the new Single-cell analysis with Bioconductor <https://carpentries-incubator.github.io/bioc-scrnaseq/>.

If you're available to teach, please let me know:
Which workshop you’d be interested in teaching
If you are able to self-fund your travel to/from Barcelona for the workshops.

Deadline: Friday, March 7th

If you need more time to figure out if you can, just let me know.

Thanks!

Maria

Maria Doyle, PhD

Bioconductor Community Manager

School of Medicine,

University of Limerick, Limerick, V94 T9PX
Ireland

Email: maria...@ul.ie
Phone (office): +353 61 234 768

Connect with the Bioconductor community at our conferences:
GBCC 2025 (June 23-26, New York, USA) <https://gbcc2025.org/>
EuroBioC 2025 (September 17-19, Barcelona, Spain) <https://www.linkedin.com/posts/bioconductor_eurobioc2024-eurobioc2025-activity-7237888796564885505-hUW6>

I work flexible hours across several time zones. I don't expect you to read or respond to my emails outside of your normal working hours.
